failed_previous_attempt.missing: No finalized summary, cutoff person-set sample, or final counter aggregate was saved.

schema.service_order: Same-clock observations are ties; observation_order is logging order. Person changes are discrete native sample intervals, not continuous exact boarding times.

event_time_sources.board_alight: person_sample_interval at discrete native person observations

schema.person_station_source: Native current/just-served stop with interval uncertainty, or current TraCI stop only when isAtBusStop confirms it; otherwise station remains missing. Do not order unknown-location person changes as definite stop services.
schema.cumulative_clock: Costs are exact cumulative-ledger differences. Align stocks with low/high_inventory_observed_at, which can precede the ledger row clock; missing clocks remain null.
schema.event_matching: Same kind/line/bus/station and occurrence number; matched board/alight records do not imply the same passenger cohort.

decision.next: Review matched-clock service order, capacity and queue associations before selecting one issue-observable model change.

limitations: Only three predeclared stable seed6201 late states. Service associations do not uniquely identify a cost mechanism; future service events remain diagnostic truth, never fitting inputs.
